title: Process Engineering Intern (Summer 2027)
description_text: Acme Materials builds next-generation battery cathode materials at scale. As a Process Engineering Intern you will work with the pilot line team to characterize furnace uniformity, run designed experiments on calcination parameters, and build the data pipeline that turns furnace logs into yield dashboards. You will present your findings to the manufacturing leadership team at the end of the summer. Requirements: currently pursuing a BS or MS in chemical, materials, or mechanical engineering; comfortable with Python or MATLAB; hands-on lab experience preferred.

title: Supply Chain Intern (Summer 2027)
description_text: Acme Materials builds next-generation battery cathode materials at scale. As a Supply Chain Intern you will map the precursor supplier base, build a landed-cost model for lithium and nickel feedstocks, and support the sourcing team through a supplier qualification cycle. Requirements: pursuing a degree in supply chain, industrial engineering, or business; strong Excel; SQL a plus.

title: Process Engineering Intern
description_text: Beta Energy is building modular hydrogen electrolyzers. The Process Engineering Intern will support stack testing, develop P&IDs for the next test cell, and analyze balance-of-plant efficiency data.
